drivingQuestion: Did the Rabbis disagree with Shimon HaTimni only regarding Shabbat, or even regarding weekdays?
outcomeNote: the dilemma is resolved in the next unit (taanit.sugya095)

segments.he: שִׁמְעוֹן הַתִּימְנִי אוֹמֵר: אַף עַל הַדֶּבֶר כּוּ׳. אִיבַּעְיָא לְהוּ: לֹא הוֹדוּ לוֹ חֲכָמִים בַּשַּׁבָּת, אֲבָל בַּחוֹל — הוֹדוּ לוֹ, אוֹ דִלְמָא: לֹא הוֹדוּ לוֹ כְּלָל?
segments.en: § The mishna taught that «Shimon the Timnite says:» One may cry out on Shabbat «even for pestilence,» but the Rabbis did not agree with him. «A dilemma was raised before» the Sages: Does this mean that «the Rabbis did not agree with him» with regard to crying out in these cases «on Shabbat,» but if they occur «on a weekday they agreed with him? Or perhaps they did not agree with him at all,» as they maintain that one never cries out over pestilence.
